## Featured Projects

### 1. CutCount — Local Barber Tracking & Earnings App
- **Category**: Mobile App (Business / Finance)
- **Platforms**: Android, iOS
- **Tech Stack**: Flutter, Dart, Isar DB, Provider
- **Description**: A private, 100% offline mobile application designed specifically for barbers and stylists to log daily haircut counts, categorize services, track tips, and automatically compute weekly and monthly earnings without requiring internet access.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/fazal-e-haq/CutCount.git
- **Key Features**: Offline-first storage with Isar DB, instant revenue calculation, custom rate cards, tactile hand-drawn interface.

### 2. CopyFlutter — Open-Source Flutter UI Component & Template Library
- **Category**: Web Application / Developer Tooling
- **Platforms**: Flutter Web, Android, iOS
- **Tech Stack**: Flutter Web, Firebase, GetX, Dart
- **Description**: A curated open-source library of responsive, copy-paste Flutter UI components, interactive widgets, loaders, buttons, and production-ready templates built to accelerate developer workflows.
- **Live Website**: https://copy-flutter.web.app
- **Repository**: https://copy-flutter.web.app
- **Key Features**: Live interactive widget previews, instant copy-to-clipboard code snippets, zero external bloated dependencies, mobile-responsive layout.
